tailwind-html-templates.description: Adds .html templates to the Tailwind content glob, which the build now reads

accessibility-traits.description: Renames accessibility-trait, which Lynx ignores, to accessibility-traits

extract-i18n-target.description: Adds the extract-i18n target that ng extract-i18n needs, with the AngularLynx builder

dev-logs-gitignore.description: Adds .dev-logs, where ng serve writes LynxLogger's output, to .gitignore

tailwind-lynx-utilities.description: Imports @blotch/angular-lynx/tailwind.css, Lynx's own utilities and variants, after Tailwind 4
